preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(M) == 26 and all(c.isalpha() and c.islower() for c in M) and sorted(M) == sorted('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
preconditions.description: M is a lowercase permutation of the English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) > 0 and len(S) <= 100 and all(c.isalpha() or c in {'_', '.', ',', '!', '?'} for c in S) for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence S is non-empty, has at most 100 characters, and contains only letters, underscores, or punctuation.

postconditions.expression: all(len(translated_sentence) == len(original_sentence) for original_sentence, translated_sentence in zip(sentences, output_lines))
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence has the same length as the original Bytelandian sentence.

postconditions.expression: all(original_sentence[i] == translated_sentence[i] if original_sentence[i] in {'_', '.', ',', '!', '?'} else False for original_sentence, translated_sentence in zip(sentences, output_lines) for i in range(len(original_sentence)))
postconditions.description: Punctuation symbols and underscores in the original sentence remain unchanged in the translated sentence.

postconditions.expression: all(original_sentence[i].isupper() == translated_sentence[i].isupper() for original_sentence, translated_sentence in zip(sentences, output_lines) for i in range(len(original_sentence)))
postconditions.description: Uppercase letters in the original sentence remain uppercase in the translated sentence, and lowercase letters remain lowercase.

postconditions.expression: all(original_sentence[i].islower() and translated_sentence[i] == M[ord(original_sentence[i]) - ord('a')] or original_sentence[i].isupper() and translated_sentence[i] == M[ord(original_sentence[i].lower()) - ord('a')].upper() for original_sentence, translated_sentence in zip(sentences, output_lines) for i in range(len(original_sentence)))
postconditions.description: Each letter in the original sentence is translated to its corresponding English letter using the mapping M, preserving case.
Each translated sentence has underscores replaced by spaces in the output.
